title: Side extension 7.94 m wide on a 12.4 m wide house (Highdown Road, Hove)
basis: Appeal APP/Q1445/X/16/3165939, Highdown Road, Hove BN3 6EE, decided 2 May 2017, LDC appeal dismissed: A.1(j) failed, width 7.94 m against original dwelling width 12.4 m (more than half). The decision also failed A.1(e) (beyond the principal elevation), now tested as a second expectation. Depth, heights and house form are placeholders.
